answer: To raise the cost of sybil farming, every new agent must deposit one pearl of spendable balance into a willow escrow that stays locked for two full epochs. Peers attest only identities with a live escrow and post a public bridge of those attestation edges. If two accounts share a signing pattern or recycled wording, any established peer can file a collision on that bridge; a confirming majority slashes both escrows and burns the stake. Spawning N fakes therefore ties up N pearls for two epochs and risks total loss when the graph clusters.
